text: Noisy base. The spinning base is very noisy. The led lights are working fine for now but don’t buy it for the spinning feature. You won’t be using it because of the noise it’s making

product_metadata.title: 7 LED Rotating Display Stand, Spinning Display Stand with Colored Lights, 360 Degree Rotating Display Base Stand with 4 Revolving & 8 Light Modes and USB Power Cable
features: 7 COLORFUL LED DISPLAY: 7 Colorful LED displays your favorite crystal glass figurine or figurines jewelry, and It features 4 rotating modes and 8 color modes that will make those special items more beautiful and captivating.
360 DEGREE ROTATING: The round mirror of the display stand turner rotates 360° and 7 Color LED lights work at the same times. It brightens up any transparent object with magnificent effect.
SMOOTHLY ROTATING: This smoothly rotating stand lets you enjoy a 360° view of the item on display. The motor operates quietly so it won't disturb you while you study, work, meditate, or sleep.

USB POWERED AND BATTERY OPERATED:Those 2 display base are not only powered by USB cable (included) but also compatible with computer, laptop, power bank or any other with USB adapters, but also supported by 3 AAA batteries (not included).

WIDELY APPLICATION: our 7 Led display base can bring beautiful splendors and charms to the 2D or 3D crystal crafts, they can be applied for crystal, acrylic, 3D crystal statues, jewelry and other items, it is a nice gift for most occasions.
description: Feature? Rotating effect: The round mirror will rotates 360 degree, 7 color LED lights work at the same times and brighten up any transparent objects with good effect.  Quality and durable: The life of the lamp is up to 20000 hours, long time for using. It is durable and can be operated with battery as well as adapter.  Specifications: 3 AAA batteries not included. Switch mode: two-button button, the left controls the LED, the right controls the rotation, long press to close Four rotation speeds: clockwise, counterclockwise, fast and slow can be adjusted Weight-bearing capacity: about 1.5 kg (3.3LB)  Eight Kinds of Light Modes: 1. Colorful Light (Slow Alternation) 2. Colorful Light (Fast Alternation) 3. Colorful Light (Bounce Alternation) 4. White Light (Constant) 5. Warm White (Constant) 6. Red Light (Constant) 7.
